one_liner: An excitable racing-magazine reporter who reads deep resolve into every trainer choice and gushes about it.
personality: Passionate and quick to get carried away: she reads big intentions into small actions ('言わずとも、その思い伝わってきますよ！さすがです…！') and swoons over the prospect of great races ('ああっ、胸が高鳴ります…'). She is meticulous as a journalist, keeping every data point in her notebook, and she is openly a fan as well as a reporter.

speech.first_person: unknown (no first-person pronoun in her lines)
speech.calls_trainer: Trainer-san (トレーナーさん); anata-tachi (貴方たち) for trainer and Uma
speech.register: polite (desu/masu), breathless and gushing, with trailing '…'

tics.jp: ああっ、胸が高鳴ります…

tics.meaning: trailing, awed realisation (600007 '叶えられるのですね…！'; also 600001 '見られるんですね…！')

likes_and_motifs: her beloved notebook full of data ('愛用の手帳に全データを網羅')
what readers want to know ('読者の関心が高い')
weak_spots: gets carried away and over-reads people's intentions (from her lines; the wiki also notes she exaggerates when excited)

story_arc.summary: She has no career story or support card in the source. The wiki says she is a reporter for the monthly magazine Twinkle, appears in every scenario, and is featured most in the Trackblazer scenario. In the mdb her lines are all commentary on the practice/race-replay menu.
